column3: Close to the Hebrew; “lying, plunder” is rendered “lies and robbery,” and “prey” “Its victim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a horseman bringing up” is rendered “Horsemen charge.”
Close to the Hebrew; “good of grace” is rendered “seductive.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will uncover your skirts on your face” is rendered “I will lift your skirts over your face.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will treat you with contempt” is rendered “Make you vile.”
Close to the Hebrew; “among the canals” is rendered “by the River.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Cush” is rendered “Ethiopia,” and “the Libyans” “Lubim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “take hold of the brick mold” is rendered “Make strong the brick kiln!”
Close to the Hebrew; “your courtiers” is rendered “Your commanders,” “your officials” “your generals,” and “the walls” “the hedges.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your nobles settle down” is rendered “Your nobles rest in the dust.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they strike a palm” is rendered “Will clap their hands.”
